newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China Marine to offer 48mln new B shares.
newsitem.headline: China Marine to offer 48mln new B shares.

text.p: China International Marine Containers (Group) Ltd plans to issue 48 million additional foreign currency B shares, the Shenzhen Stock Exchange said in a notice after the market closed on Tuesday.
The company hopes to launch the offer after it issues its 1996 dividend, the exchange said, adding the plan will be tabled at a forthcoming annual general meeting of shareholders.
Trading in the company's A and B shares will be suspended on Wednesday morning and resume in the afternoon, the exchange said. It gave no more details on the issue.
The firm on Saturday posted net profits of 182.31 million yuan for 1996 against 138.9 million yuan for 1995 based on international accounting standards.

China Marine proposed to make a three-for-10 bonus share issue and a cash dividend of 0.1 yuan per share based on 1996 profits, pending approval of shareholders at a meeting on May 17, the company's 1996 annual report said.
